title: Wonderful gothic and Sagrada Família tour!
text: Four of us had an exceptional tour of the historic area of Barcelona and the Sagrada Família with Gerardo! He was so knowledgeable and personalable! He showed us such a variety of Barcelona sights and gave us so much history. If you want the best tour of Barcelona, don’t hesitate to contact Book My Guide Barcelona and ask for Gerardo. He will give you a day of memories that you will never forget!
author: poultondana

title: Great tour and learned a lot
text: We had a great tour of the Gothic Quarter. It was reasonably priced for a small/private tour for 5 of us, we had lots of time to explore and ask questions, and learned a lot about the history of the area and Barcelona. An excellent experience!
author: jas151
